blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats to cruise on Bayou Chico with options including double-decker Tiki Hut-themed boats with a waterslide, restroom, and propane grill, or smaller Bentley Navigator series boats. Rentals include safety instruction and adherence to Florida boating laws. Boats can be taken to Robertson Island or Pensacola Beach within authorized areas but not into the Gulf of America or the Pass.
extraNote: Cancel up to 14 days before with 10% fee; up to 7 days with 50% fee; up to 48 hours with gift card; day of forfeits all money · Inclement weather cancellations may be rescheduled, refunded, or credited with gift card · Fuel not included; renter pays for fuel used or $50 convenience fee plus fuel cost if refilled by operator · No refunds for no-shows · Bayou Chico, Pensacola
